nodes.label: Work Sans Font
nodes.rationale: Work Sans is distributed under the SIL Open Font License v1.1 so it can be used, studied, modified and redistributed freely; derivatives must remain under this license and cannot be sold by themselves.

nodes.label: SIL Open Font License 1.1
nodes.rationale: OFL goals are to stimulate collaborative font projects and provide a free open framework for sharing fonts; it does not require documents created using the fonts to stay under the license.

nodes.label: Young Serif Font
nodes.rationale: Young Serif is distributed under the SIL Open Font License v1.1 so it can be bundled, embedded, redistributed and sold with software as long as it is not sold by itself and derivatives stay under this license.

nodes.label: Two-Phase Design Process
nodes.rationale: Design operates through two-phase: Phase 1 creates a pure visual philosophy (aesthetic movement, not layouts); Phase 2 expresses it via canvas artifacts at ~90% visual / 10% text.

nodes.label: Visual Communication First Principle
nodes.rationale: Information lives in design, not paragraphs; express through color zones, geometric precision, spatial relationships, and visual weight.

nodes.label: Minimal Text Integration Principle
nodes.rationale: Text is a rare, powerful gesture: never paragraphs, only essential words integrated into the visual architecture, typography as a visual element.

nodes.label: Systematic Patterns Principle
nodes.rationale: Use repeating patterns, perfect shapes, dense accumulation of marks, and layered elements; patient repetition rewards sustained viewing.

nodes.label: oklch Intentional Palette
nodes.rationale: Limited 2-5 color cohesive palette in oklch color space for precision; each shade carries meaning.

nodes.label: Radix UI Primitives
nodes.rationale: shadcn/ui built on unstyled Radix UI primitives following WAI-ARIA patterns: built-in keyboard navigation, screen reader announcements, focus management, auto-applied ARIA attributes.

nodes.label: WCAG Color Contrast Requirements
nodes.rationale: AA = 4.5:1 normal / 3:1 large text; AAA = 7:1 / 4.5:1. Use semantic muted-foreground tokens rather than low-contrast gray.

nodes.label: shadcn CLI (npx shadcn add)
nodes.rationale: Components install to components/ui/ with automatic dependency management.

nodes.rationale: Modern CSS-based customization: define colors, fonts, spacing, breakpoints, shadows, radius in @theme.

nodes.label: Mobile-First Approach
nodes.rationale: Base styles apply to all sizes; breakpoint prefixes override at larger sizes; test at breakpoint boundaries.

nodes.label: Node.js + npm + shadcn CLI Prerequisite
nodes.rationale: Skill uses stdlib only for Python; requires Node 18+, npm, and per-project npx shadcn init. No Python package deps.
